questions.text: Discuss the PASS theory of intelligence and highlight its theoretical foundation.
Explain the meaning of creativity and describe the stages of creativity.
Describe the stages of language acquisition. Explain the behaviouristic theory of language acquisition.
Discuss Newell's approach to problem solving. Explain the role of artificial intelligence in problem solving.
Discuss the key issues in the study of cognitive psychology.
Explain the principles of information processing.
Explain Waugh and Norman's model of primary and secondary memory.
Explain the single system versus dual system hypotheses in reference to multilingualism.
Explain the 'backward search' and 'thinking aloud' as techniques of problem solving.
